tracks.title: AI & Deep Learning Engineer
tracks.description: Architects neural networks, fine-tunes open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral), and integrates high-throughput inference systems with vector databases.

roadmap_90days.focus: Deep Math & PyTorch Autograd from Scratch

roadmap_90days.project: Fine-tune Mistral 7B on domain-specific medical dataset with Unsloth
Hybrid BM25 + dense search pipeline with LangGraph & reranker
Self-hosted Dockerized vLLM cluster with Triton Inference Server

resume_bullets: Engineered end-to-end RAG system indexing 1.2M technical documents using Qdrant and Cohere rerank, improving answer accuracy from 64% to 94.2%.
Fine-tuned Mistral-7B using QLoRA for automated SQL generation, reducing query drafting time by 68% for non-technical team members.
Deployed low-latency LLM inference cluster with vLLM and continuous batching on 4x A100 GPUs, slashing p99 latency by 53% while doubling throughput.
Implemented real-time guardrails with Llama-Guard and NeMo, cutting hallucination and prompt-injection vulnerabilities to <0.4%.

interview_questions.question: What is the difference between RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding) and ALiBi, and how does RoPE extrapolate to longer context windows?
interview_questions.key_points: Complex rotation of 2D pairs, dot-product property preserving relative distance, YaRN / NTK-aware scaling for length extrapolation.

interview_questions.question: Walk me through how FlashAttention v2 achieves 2-4x speedup over standard scaled dot-product attention.
interview_questions.key_points: Tiling, avoiding materialization of full N x N matrix in HBM, online softmax normalization, SRAM memory hierarchy exploitation.

tracks.title: Generative AI Systems Architect
tracks.description: Designs scalable enterprise architectures combining autonomous agents, multi-modal pipelines, governance, and cost-efficient LLM routing.

roadmap_90days.project: Hierarchical multi-agent research analyst with human-in-the-loop approval
CI/CD automated regression testing using Ragas metrics
Dynamic router directing 70% of prompts to 8B models and 30% to Frontier models
PII redaction and SOC2-compliant logging sidecar

resume_bullets: Architected multi-model gateway handling 4.5M monthly API calls, using cascade routing to save $34,000/month in OpenAI API spend.
Built resilient multi-agent automation workflow using LangGraph that parsed 50,000 legal contracts with 99.1% extraction accuracy.
Set up comprehensive automated evaluation pipeline evaluating answer relevance, context recall, and faithfulness across every PR build.

interview_questions.question: How do you mitigate cascading error degradation in multi-step agentic workflows?
interview_questions.key_points: State checkpoints, structured JSON schemas, validator agents, self-reflection loops, and deterministic fallback fall-throughs.

tracks.title: MLOps & AI Infrastructure Engineer
tracks.description: Builds and operates scalable GPU infrastructure, automated training pipelines, model registries, and zero-downtime canary deployment systems.

roadmap_90days.project: Ray Train cluster fine-tuning multi-GPU checkpointed model
Deploy automated autoscaling GPU cluster with spot instance preemption handlers
Prometheus exporter monitoring GPU memory, KV cache utilization, and embedding drift
Istio traffic-split routing 5% shadow traffic to candidate LLM

resume_bullets: Orchestrated Ray cluster on AWS EKS with GPU spot instances, reducing model training infrastructure costs by 52%.
Built automated CI/CD pipeline triggering model evaluation on fresh test sets, maintaining zero regression across 24 production releases.
Instrumented deep observability dashboards with Prometheus/Grafana tracking KV cache eviction rate, TTFT (time-to-first-token), and tokens/sec.

interview_questions.question: Explain PagedAttention and how it solves memory fragmentation in LLM serving.
interview_questions.key_points: Dynamic allocation of non-contiguous physical memory blocks for KV cache, virtual memory concept adapted for GPU VRAM, 2-4x higher batch sizes.

tracks.title: Full-Stack AI Application Engineer
tracks.description: Builds reactive real-time web applications with streaming AI responses, optimistic UI updates, web workers, and rock-solid backend services.
skills_required: Vercel AI SDK & IndexedDB Local Caching

roadmap_90days.project: Real-time canvas with streaming token rendering and diff viewer
Offline-capable semantic search using WebGPU transformers in browser
Stripe + token usage metering gateway with Redis rate limiting

resume_bullets: Developed high-concurrency streaming AI interface using Next.js 15 and Server-Sent Events, achieving sub-200ms perceived latency.
Integrated pgvector with HNSW index for sub-5ms similarity searches across 300,000 user embeddings in PostgreSQL.
Constructed client-side local caching engine using IndexedDB, reducing repeated API calls by 41% and speeding up page reloads by 8x.

interview_questions.question: How do Server-Sent Events (SSE) differ from WebSockets when delivering streaming LLM completions?
interview_questions.key_points: Unidirectional vs bidirectional, HTTP/2 multiplexing, automatic reconnects, simpler firewall/proxy traversal.
